title: Effects of Watermelon Consumption on Satiety and Digestive Health
official: Effects of Watermelon Consumption on Satiety and Digestive Health
summary: The objective of the proposed research is to determine the effects of watermelon (fruit and rind blenderized) on satiety, metabolic markers, bowel habits, microbiome and weight management in children and adults
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Generally healthy subjects

Exclusion Criteria:

* Smoker
* Pregnant woman
* Required dietary supplement use
* Required medication of metabolic disorders
* Allergy to watermelon

sites.f: School of Exercise and Nutritional Sciences, SDSU
